description: Rejected native Enyo 8-bucket CP-only Bullet/Test80 smoke. Kept only as the last completed reproducible training config; do not rerun without a new hypothesis.

metadata.hypothesis: The one-bucket Test80 CP-only smoke proved that the Test80 source alone does not recover move-choice behavior: checkpoints 512-2048 stayed near 25% top1 with candidate_better 66-70 vs reference_better about 500. The best prior native shape used a real 8-runtime-bucket layout on Test79 and reached about 46% top1. This run tests whether that lower-bucket geometry plus the newer Test80 source improves the native baseline without adding WDL or policy complexity yet.
metadata.previous_result: native-bullet-test80-enyo1-cp-smoke-eval400-lr1e3-sb2048 rejected: checkpoint 2048 all top1 205/800, candidate_better 70 vs reference_better 501, capped -67617, worst -32000.
metadata.result: rejected: checkpoints 512-2048 all failed; best all top1 was 2048 at 195/800, candidate_better 69 vs reference_better 525, capped -76578, worst -32000.
metadata.data_audit: runs/native-test80-jan2024-data-audit-20260524/run.log: 1M rows sampled; result win/draw/loss 17.75/63.14/19.11; score_result_agree 83.79% on non-draws.
constraints: CP-only objective first; no WDL until the data-source effect is known
real 8 train-time and runtime input buckets
checkpoint gate before any continuation or SPRT

validation.first_gate: checkpoint sweep at 512, 1024, 1536, and 2048 on the 800-target Lichess-policy gate, reusing the cached reference CSV.
validation.continue_only_if: This must materially beat the prior Test79 real-8-runtime run, especially checkpoint 1536: all top1 371/800, candidate_better 82 vs reference_better 277, capped -19627, worst -32000.
validation.promotion: No SPRT unless checkpoint gate and failure-suite replay are clean.
